defects.description: The term 'authoritative name servers' is translated as 'авторитативные серверы имен', which is a non-existent word in Russian and violates the required glossary term 'авторитетный сервер имён'.
Redundant phrasing: 'записей Обратной записи DNS' literally translates to 'entries of Reverse DNS record'.
Unnecessary bolding and capitalization of the word 'Конфигурации' which is not present in the source text.
